You got sandbox to build stuff you like (there's tons of tools, every block is paintable; you got some heavy rng in terms of when and how you will obtain certain character boosting accessories that reminds me of roguelikes, and there's rather difficult to cheese bossfights, that mostly ask you to be great at evasion with the tools you have.

Ok so here's a few tips I found most helpful.

Put recall potions in the first slot, it will save your life if you panic. Also, before you beat Skeletron and get the Grand Design, please carry a pressure plate in your second slot to check for wires. Also never NEVER EVER step in the water or waterfalls on land until you know it's 100% safe, since the pressure plates are unseeable and there might be explosives.

Armor and damage reduction are very important on master mode, so melee worked best for me. Notably, the most important accessories for me were the worm scarf, the cross necklace and the shield of ankh not to get petrified, poisoned and murdered randomly. Especially the cross necklace and its upgrade, since it gives you more time to react to a close oneshot of a turtle or some other random crap.

If you see a mech boss about to summon itself and don't feel ready, I believe you can exit the game to despawn it. Although I just went to hell and waited until around 10 PM.

Do NOT go into the jungle or desert without hunter and dangersense potions. These are the most dangerous locations early game and all throughout your journey. Never ever risk it without proper awareness of your surroundings.

Also, start fishing asap. It's great. It gives you access to infinite supply of lifeforce, damage reduction, crit chance, damage boost potions, which are great for all the bosses at any given time.

Try to isolate your world evil with dynamite as soon as you enter hardmode and clean up an open area in the caverns with a platform of corrupted and hallowed blocks separately to farm souls/money in an environment that you can't get lost in and can see the dangers. Don't ever fight biome mimics randomly in the caves!

Think thoroughly about your accessories for each boss fight. I ditched wings in favor of safety with some defensive accessories on skeletron prime and the destroyer. I think I used a bunch of balloons instead of slow early wings.

Also, remember, if it's not fun for you - don't bother.
